title: Claude Code marketplace catalog (local compatibility schema)
$comment: LOCAL COMPATIBILITY SCHEMA -- NOT AN OFFICIAL HOST SCHEMA. Host behaviour remains authoritative; this schema encodes only the subset of fields agent-harness relies on at M1, so it can catch our own mistakes early. A file passing this schema is not thereby guaranteed to be accepted by the host. Official documentation: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces

name.$comment: Official-Documented: the vendor schema table states 'Marketplace identifier (kebab-case, no spaces)'. M1.3 removed this pattern as an invented constraint -- that was a REGRESSION, corrected in M1.3.1. Canonical kebab-case. The vendor states 'kebab-case, no spaces' and its validator rejects uppercase, spaces and special characters; rejection of leading, trailing and repeated hyphens is a Local-M1-Policy refinement of that term, not a separately published rule.

plugins.$comment: An empty catalog is rejected: it registers a source that offers nothing.

name.$comment: Official-Documented: the vendor schema table states 'Plugin identifier (kebab-case, no spaces)', and the host validator reports a kebab-case error when a plugin name contains uppercase letters, spaces or special characters. Restored in M1.3.1 after an incorrect M1.3 removal. Canonical kebab-case. The vendor states 'kebab-case, no spaces' and its validator rejects uppercase, spaces and special characters; rejection of leading, trailing and repeated hyphens is a Local-M1-Policy refinement of that term, not a separately published rule.

source.$comment: M1 uses a repo-relative path only.

category.$comment: Official-Documented as a free-form organisational string. NOT an identifier: the kebab-case pattern M1.1 imposed here WAS an invention and stays removed.
